## Gráfica de la FDP

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5
x <- seq(-4, 4, length = 400)
fx <- dnorm(x)
plot(x, fx, type = "l", lwd = 3, col = "#006DAE",
     main = "FDP: Normal estándar N(0,1)",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "f(x)", cex.lab = 1.3, cex.main = 1.3)
xi <- seq(-1, 1, length = 200)
polygon(c(-1, xi, 1), c(0, dnorm(xi), 0), col = "#bfdbfe", border = NA)
text(0, 0.15, paste0("P(-1 ≤ X ≤ 1) ≈ ", round(diff(pnorm(c(-1,1))),3)),
     cex = 1.3, col = "#1a3a6b")
abline(h = 0, col = "gray60")
```
